text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH 5xx error-rate on inference-gateway-usw2. Trigger: error_rate > 5% over 2m. INC12345. Pager: @morgan. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345

morgan: acked. I'm taking this. Starting quick triage. 

devon: seeing elevated 502s from edge -> gateway. Quick look at logs shows a spike in downstream timeouts to kv-proxy. 

kyle-sre: can you paste the query that's failing? Also checking health of gw pods now. `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep gateway` shows 6/6 up but CPU at ~85% on two nodes.

jaime: customer impact: metrics show ~12% of requests to /v1/generate returning 502 in US-WEST2, small subset of high-concurrency customers affected. No billing alerts yet.

morgan: running `curl -sS https://gateway-usw2/health | jq .` -> all services report ok. But headers show longer latencies to kv-proxy: `x-kv-latency: 700ms`.

devon: rolling tail logs: ```2024-04-12T01:02:11Z ERROR upstream timeout id=abcd1234 route=/v1/generate latency=702ms```. Looks like transient timeouts to a particular kv-proxy AZ.

kyle-sre: initiating traffic-slice away from AZ-b to reduce blast radius. Command: `trafficctl shift --from=usw2-azb --to=usw2-azc --weight=75% --dry-run=false`

jaime: ETA on shift? customers in AZ-b will see reduced load almost immediately. I'll ping support to flag high-concurrency tenants.

morgan: shift executed. Observability: error rate dropped from 12% -> 4.5% within 90s. :thumbsup:

devon: continuing to dig into kv-proxy nodes in AZ-b. I see OOM events in the sidecar logs around the spike window. Might be a memory pressure + GC stall.

kyle-sre: scaling kv-proxy pool in AZ-b by +2 replicas now: `kubectl scale deploy/kv-proxy -n infra --replicas=6 --selector=az=azb`

jaime: letting support know customers impacted and that we've applied a mitigation (traffic shift + scale). Suggest telling customers we'll continue to monitor and follow up with post-incident notes if they saw errors.

morgan: monitoring. Adding a short-term alert to suppress pager flood: `incident-bot note: suppress duplicate INC12345 for 10m` to avoid noisy duplicates.

devon: after scale, OOMs stop; tail of logs shows improved kv latency to ~120ms. Error rate trending to baseline ~0.9%.

morgan: excellent. I'm going to handoff to devon for follow-up/root cause and create the incident tracker in JIRA: INF-9876. Oncall rotation note: devon will own the follow-up for next 2 hours.

jaime: thanks team. I'll draft a short customer update and classification as "partial degradation - transient".

morgan: closing on-call handoff. Will update INC12345 with mitigation timeline and next steps. :white_check_mark:
